intro: Desperate Prayer is a rite of passage for fledgling human priests in Stormwind City. Bestowed by High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light, it marks an acolyte's dedication to preserving life across the turbulent lands of the Alliance. By completing this spiritual instruction, priests are granted an emergency blessing to heal their own wounds when all else fails.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done the Light a great service by becoming a shining example to those who travel in these dangerous lands and beyond. Please, accept this lesson as a thanks for all you've done.
